integrity: The stable-set vertex structure, exact threshold equation, vertex distance identity, and weighted contact barycenter form a complete symbolic proof. Exact rational finite-case enumeration is independently replayable and is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty classes and the standard 0/1 indicator-coordinate Euclidean metric. It does not apply to fractional stable-set polytopes, affine transformations, or arbitrary graph classes.
title: Large-part screening in minimum spheres of complete multipartite stable-set polytopes
